selection_objective: Maximise total design-period customer savings among feasible grid combinations
assignment_rule: Assign time-of-use only when design-period charges are lower; otherwise retain flat pricing
validation_rule: Keep prices and assignments unchanged during evaluation
limitations: Assignments simulate switching, not actual customer uptake.
Consumption is held unchanged across tariffs.
Standing charges and fixed costs are excluded.
Design-period savings do not guarantee validation-period savings.
